result.description: Front is a customer operations platform (shared inbox, helpdesk, AI) with a Core API for conversations, contacts, messages and more.
result.auth_detail: Core API uses Bearer tokens, obtained either as company-level API tokens (admin creates in settings) or via OAuth2 authorization-code flow (access token 60 min, refresh 6 months). OAuth required for public integrations; MCP server needs OAuth, not API tokens.
result.access_detail: Create a developer app / API token as a Front admin. Docs show no plan restriction on API access. Pricing: free 14-day trial of Professional, no credit card; Starter $25, Professional $65, Enterprise $105 per seat/mo. Public OAuth apps are required for multi-customer integrations (exception needed otherwise); end users authorizing OAuth must be admins. Free trial only; no permanent free tier seen.
result.api_notes: Core API covers core data and actions (conversations, messages, contacts, inboxes, tags, teammates, etc.). Full endpoint count not verified from the fetched pages; the reference is at dev.frontapp.com/reference. Rate limits can be raised by an add-on on all plans. Plus Application/Channel APIs.
result.blocker: Trial-only free access; admin needed to create tokens or authorize OAuth; public OAuth apps need a developer app and may need Front approval or an exception. Otherwise buildable.

evidence.quote: The Core API uses Bearer tokens to authenticate its user.
There are two ways to get a Bearer token — through API tokens in your settings or through an OAuth implementation
OAuth is required for public integrations available to all Front customers unless you obtain an exception from us.
You must be an admin to create or manage API tokens.
Our free 14-day trial offers all the features available in our Professional plan.
The Core API allows you as a Front developer to access core data and actions within Front.
